calculation.description: Contrarian overnight return signal, amplified after a five-session VIX shock. Uses only the completed session open/close and lagged observation-only VIX; higher values indicate stronger expected reversal.
calculation.timing: Signal at decision date uses data through the prior completed trading day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily signal is positive over the full sample; 10-day predictive power decays. Conservative interpretation warranted due to 15-asset cross-section and missing early observations from VIX alignment.
